temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn has been unusually quiet and withdrawn over the past few days. When Carolyn asks about it, Marilyn says she is overwhelmed with work and personal stuff and thanks her for asking.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Marilyn is normally engaging and there was no particular concern about her well-being.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Marilyn is not acting like herself because she is overwhelmed by work and personal issues.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn is under significant stress and may need support, though she has not shared details.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Offer support and let Marilyn know Carolyn is available to talk.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn responded curtly in a later interaction, which confused and slightly hurt Carolyn. Carolyn shares her own past struggles and says talking can help. Marilyn apologizes, says she seemed off because of a hard week, and appreciates Carolyn.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Marilyn is overwhelmed and Carolyn's earlier approach may have overstepped or created a misunderstanding.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Marilyn's curtness was likely due to her hard week rather than something Carolyn did; she is receptive to Carolyn's support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: The misunderstanding is eased, and Marilyn still appreciates Carolyn's concern while dealing with a difficult time.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Confused and slightly hurt, then reassured and sympathetic
temporal_state_chain.intention: Clear any misunderstanding and continue showing support to Marilyn.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn responded positively to Carolyn's openness, making Carolyn feel relieved and hopeful. Carolyn invites Marilyn to a small gathering, and Marilyn accepts, saying it sounds lovely.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Marilyn is stressed but receptive to Carolyn's support, and their relationship is warming.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Marilyn is open to social connection and would like to join Carolyn's gathering.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Carolyn and Marilyn are developing a friendship, and Marilyn is interested in strengthening their bond.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Strengthen the friendship by hosting Marilyn at the gathering.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Despite friendly interactions outside work, Marilyn still seems to keep a professional distance at the bank. When Carolyn raises this, Marilyn says she did not realize it, apologizes, and agrees they should talk about improving collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: They are building a friendship outside work, and Carolyn hopes that closeness will also appear in their work interactions.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: There is a work dynamic distance Carolyn had not understood, but Marilyn was not intentionally distant and is willing to discuss it.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: The distance is acknowledged and may be improveable through direct conversation, though it is not yet fully resolved.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Disappointed, then cautiously reassured and hopeful
temporal_state_chain.intention: Address the work dynamic directly and improve collaboration with Marilyn.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After their private meeting, Carolyn believes they cleared the air and better understand each other's professional expectations and personal boundaries. Carolyn proposes teaming up on a new project, and Marilyn enthusiastically agrees, saying she is glad they talked.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: They had acknowledged the work distance and planned to improve collaboration, but Carolyn was not yet certain how well they understood each other.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: The private meeting resolved tensions, clarified boundaries and expectations, and Marilyn is eager to work more closely together.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Carolyn and Marilyn share a better mutual understanding and a stronger professional partnership.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Team up with Marilyn on the new project proposal and further their partnership.
